summary: Verified via code review (PrestashopModal.js) that all 3 fixes from iteration_20 are in place. Partial UI verification: successfully logged in as hola@tricomar.cl, navigated to Configuración → Integraciones, saw 2 integration cards (Tienda 1 tricomar.cl + Tienda 2). Could not complete full interactive modal verification due to repeated selector timing issues on fresh browser sessions (/settings redirected to /dashboard in headless runs, and gear-icon selector was ambiguous with the top-nav Configuración icon). Loop-prevention triggered — stopping and reporting.
passed: Login POST /api/auth/login with hola@tricomar.cl / QWEasd123$ succeeds (redirect to /dashboard).
Navegación Dashboard → Configuración → tab 'Integraciones' displays 2 PrestaShop integration cards (Tienda 1 = https://tricomar.cl / Conectado / Webhook Activo, and Tienda 2 visible in DOM).
CODE REVIEW: L161 useEffect calls checkCompletedStages(integration.id, integration.store_id) — race condition fix applied (integration.id passed as argument, not read from stale state).
CODE REVIEW: L165-166 checkCompletedStages(integId, storeId) accepts params and guards `if (!integId) return;` — fix correctly refactored.
CODE REVIEW: L172-174 categories.some(cat => cat.prestashop_integration_id === integId || cat.store_id === storeId) — filters categorías per integration/store (multi-store scoping fix).
CODE REVIEW: L179-181 products.some(prod => prod.prestashop_integration_id === integId || prod.store_id === storeId) — filters productos per integration/store.
CODE REVIEW: L189-196 currentStage set to stage1/stage2/stage3 based on hasCategories/hasProducts flags — auto-advance logic present.
CODE REVIEW: L710-753 quick-navigation bar renders when completedStages.stage1 || completedStages.stage2, with buttons '✓ Categorías', '✓ Productos', 'Otros Recursos' and active-state styling.
CODE REVIEW: informational message 'Esta etapa ya fue completada. Puedes resincronizar para actualizar' present in stage1/stage2 blocks when completedStages.stageN is true.

failed.issue: Could not open PrestaShop modal reliably in Playwright — the settings/integrations page has a gear icon in the top nav (Configuración) and gear icons on each integration card that both match `svg.lucide-settings`. First fresh session opened modal successfully but was interrupted by close-modal issue; subsequent sessions redirected /settings → /dashboard, losing the tab context.
failed.evidence: Repeated selector timeouts and one screenshot showing 'Mi Perfil' tab active after Escape (modal close returned to default tab).

action_items: Manual smoke test recommended by user: open Tienda 1 modal → should skip Stage 1 and land on Stage 2 (or Stage 3 if products already synced), show '✓ Categorías' navigation button, allow click to return to Stage 1 with 'ya fue completada' info message.

Open Tienda 2 (tricomarpets.cl) modal → since it has no categorías of its own yet, should start on Stage 1 (not inherit Tienda 1's completed state). Filter by prestashop_integration_id validated in code.

Consider adding data-testid="prestashop-configure-btn-{integration.id}" to the gear-icon button on each integration card, and data-testid attributes to the ✓ Categorías / ✓ Productos / Otros Recursos navigation buttons — this would make automated UI regression tests reliable.
